source.publisher: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
source.title: Technology appraisal and highly specialised technologies guidance: the manual, economic evaluation

rights.terms: Official public NICE guidance; retain attribution and link; no private submission material included
rights.permitted_destination: research-only method ledger and source citation

disposition.rationale: Supports 3.5% for costs and health effects as the NICE reference case and 1.5% only in specified circumstances; it does not supply programme parameters.
disposition.contingency: Use 3.5% primary and test 1.5% as sensitivity while programme evidence remains incomplete.
disposition.refresh_or_retry_condition: Reacquire at every release/calibration freeze or NICE update.
